data.title: São Paulo finish Fluminense prep without Bobadilla, three suspended | All Football
data.content:
São Paulo are expected to line up with: Rafael; Tolói, Arboleda, Osório; Pedro Lima, Pablo Maia (Danielzinho), Djhordney, Iago; Artur, Luciano and Calleri.

The Tricolor arrive on a run of three matches without a win in the Brasileirão. They currently sit 10th with 44 points, nine fewer than Bahia, who occupy the last of the G6 places for Libertadores qualification. [...] Dorival will be without other important players besides Bobadilla. Luciano, Newton and Ferreira picked up their third yellow cards in the derby against Corinthians before the FIFA break and must serve automatic suspensions.

Also still with the medical department are defenders Sabino and Domingos Duarte (surgery on the right knee), midfielder Marcos Antônio (right ankle injury) and full-backs Buta and Nicolas, who took the field after the group's training on Tuesday. [...] São Paulo completed their preparations for Thursday's Brasileirão match against Fluminense with a training session at the CT da Barra Funda on Wednesday, and midfielder Damián Bobadilla will not be part of the squad after serving with the Paraguay national team during the FIFA break.

The match is scheduled for 21h30 (Brasília time) on Thursday at the Morumbis, in the 35th round of the league.
